issues.line_reference: line 295 — font= parameter on error label in _on_error()
issues.violation: Raw font tuple ('Segoe UI', 12) used instead of a FONTS token. CLAUDE.md and designer role both mandate: 'Only FONTS["key"] values in component files — never raw tuples like ("Segoe UI", 13)'.
issues.fix: Import FONTS from invoy_app.styles.theme and replace font=("Segoe UI", 12) with font=FONTS["body"] (or whichever token is closest in size to 12px). This pre-exists the current spec change but the Programmer will touch this function area, so it should be fixed in the same pass.

positive_notes: The _short_model_label() change (AC-5) is pure string-matching logic — it introduces no new UI tokens, no new widgets, no hardcoded colours or spacing. There is no design regression risk from that change itself.

The AVAILABLE_MODELS change in config.py is a data-only dict update — no UI surface is affected directly. settings_window.py already iterates AVAILABLE_MODELS dynamically, so the two new InternVL2 entries will appear in the dropdown with the same styling as the existing Qwen entries without any template changes.
The existing _on_error() label correctly uses COLORS['danger'] for text_color — the semantic colour choice is right. Only the font tuple is wrong.
The content_frame uses corner_radius=0 correctly because it butts against the window edge, which is the documented exception to the RADIUS rule.
No new absolute pixel positioning is introduced by any of the spec changes.
pre_existing_issue_note: D-1 is a pre-existing violation in the codebase, not introduced by this spec. However, because _on_error() is in app.py which is listed in files_to_change, and the Programmer will be editing that file for AC-5, it is the correct moment to remediate it. Leaving it would be a missed opportunity but does not block this spec from shipping — hence 'minor' severity and 'approved_with_notes' verdict.
design_constraints_from_spec: spec.json lists design_constraints: [] — the PM explicitly declared no design constraints for this task. The review above covers only pre-existing token violations discovered during the mandatory file scan.
summary: The spec is design-safe. The only issue found is a pre-existing raw font tuple on the error label in _on_error() (line 295 of app.py) — a minor token violation that should be fixed while the Programmer is already editing that file for AC-5. All other changes in this spec (AVAILABLE_MODELS dict entries in config.py and the _short_model_label() string-matching logic in app.py) are purely non-visual and carry zero design regression risk. The settings dropdown will render the two new InternVL2 entries identically to the existing Qwen entries because settings_window.py iterates AVAILABLE_MODELS dynamically with no per-entry styling. Verdict: approved_with_notes — Programmer may fix D-1 inline or defer to a follow-up task.
